o.text: From Proto-Common Turkic *yï̄gla-. Cognate with Old Turkic [script needed] (ïgla-). Doublet of yığlamaq.
Internationalism; Likely from Russian факт (fakt), ultimately from Latin factum.
Ultimately a derivation of Proto-Turkic *sǖr-, whence also Azerbaijani sürmək. By surface analysis, sür- + -gün.
From qarala + -ma. Cognate with Turkish karalama.
From Proto-Mongolic *ǰalga- (“to fasten, join”). Compare Kazakh жалғау (jalğaw).
